options.misconception_text: Believes each recursive call enlarges the problem instead of shrinking it.

items.prompt: Which description best defines a recursive function? Pick one option and give the reason for your choice.
items.reference_answer: Recursion solves a problem by having a function call itself on a smaller subproblem, repeating until it reaches a base case that stops the calls. Shrinking the problem and the base case are what distinguish it from a loop or an ordinary call to another function. Final answer: A function that calls itself on a smaller subproblem.
